items.lede: ​Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget disclosed today that suspected North Korean hackers have stolen $351.6 million from its hot and warm wallets. [...]
items.title: Hackers steal $351.6 million in Bitget crypto exchange hack

items.lede: The $351 million theft from crypto exchange Bitget is the latest in a string of high-profile hacks targeting the crypto sector.
items.title: North Korean hackers suspected in $351M crypto theft, the largest so far this year
